author: Epic Games
description:
Whitethorn Games and Millionhare Studios are so excited to announce that Wish Upon A Llama will be releasing on December 9, 2026! https://epic.gm/wishuponallama 

Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!
title: Wish Upon A Llama Trailer | Release Date Announcement
